item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 16/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China later tomorrow. Temperatures over Guangdong will fall progressively in the following few days. Tropical Cyclone Man-yi over the seas east of the Philippines will move across Luzon and enter the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the next couple of days, and then move in the general direction of the vicinity of Hainan Island. Under its combined effect with the northeast monsoon, it will be windy with rain over the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea midweek next week. There will be swells. With Man-yi moving away from the coastal areas and weakening gradually, showers will ease off and the weather will become brighter over the region in the latter part of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Usagi will move across southern Taiwan and dissipate gradually today.
